ValidationRule.description: Invalid Bill to Code, Sold to or Ship to Code combination (EX, EO, EU)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Site__c, 'Toronto'), ISPICKVAL(SFDC_Integration_Status__c, 'In Progress'), OR( UPPER(LEFT(Ship_To_CodeLDGI__c,2))<>UPPER(LEFT( Sold_To_CodeLDGI__c,2)), UPPER(LEFT(Ship_To_CodeLDGI__c,2))<>UPPER(LEFT( Bill_to_CodeLDGI__c,2)), ISBLANK( Bill_to_CodeLDGI__c ), ISBLANK( Ship_To_CodeLDGI__c ), ISBLANK( Sold_To_CodeLDGI__c ) ), LEFT(Bill_to_CodeLDGI__c ,2)<>"99")
ValidationRule.errorMessage:
Sold to and Ship to account code prefix's must match (EX with EX, EO with EO, EU with EU)
- Neither Sold to Code, Bill to Code or Ship to Code can be blank.
